renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-protected-value shared-world guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the two named guardians or canonical internal pair and no third guardian, adviser, user figure, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection or implied person. Preserve both canonical identities, approved white-sclera purple eye construction, relative size/colors, signature props, dark-purple outlines and visible chest Stella stars. The pair plus one shared protected-value setting covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Give each guardian one independent identity, safety, relationship, resource or adjustability control and keep a broad open listening gap; never imply hierarchy, proxy decision, compulsory protection, permanent defense, correct choice, certainty, destiny or guaranteed outcome. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Boundaries, tracks, doors, boxes, trays, panels, clasps and connectors remain broken, open-notched, removable, ajar or unlatched; no closed circle, ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, cage, locked box or deterministic route. Replace literal keys with loose seal tokens. Do not add a scale; no scale is requested in this batch. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and dreamy violet-peach-gold lighting; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
